rubrics.name: Abhiyantrix Grand Evaluation Rubric
rubrics.description: Official 100-point weighted scoring standard across Technical Rigor, Innovation, Market Impact, UI/UX, and Pitch Quality.

criteria.title: Technical Depth & Architecture
criteria.description: Code complexity, elegance of architecture, robust error handling, scalability, and stack mastery.

criteria.title: Innovation & Originality
criteria.description: Uniqueness of approach, breakthrough creative problem solving, and distinct competitive advantage.

criteria.title: Real-World Impact & Viability
criteria.description: Practical utility, target demographic value, commercial or open-source potential, and feasibility.

criteria.title: UI/UX & User Experience
criteria.description: Design polish, accessibility, responsiveness, micro-interactions, and frictionless onboarding.

criteria.title: Presentation & Live Demo
criteria.description: Clarity of pitch, live demonstration execution, structured roadmap, and cohesive team delivery.
